[i]How to install !![/i]
1. Download alternative textures by peacefulend
2. download this mod
3. unzip and drop into your mods folder
4. enjoy!!!

To use this in game buy the paint bucket from robin's and use it on the calico falls painting to change it to whichever poster u want!
